checks.explanation: No fixed timeframe was given ('eventually'). As of 2026 Starship costs roughly $820-980/kg, and SpaceX's own near/medium-term targets are $67-200/kg once fully reusable, well short of the $10/kg figure cited, so the claim remains unresolved rather than falsified outright given its open-ended horizon.

sources.title: Starship Below $100/kg to Orbit: What It Takes

checks.explanation: Confirmed: Isaacman resigned as Shift4 CEO and was appointed Executive Chairman on June 5, 2025, with Taylor Lauber taking the CEO title, exactly matching the prediction (he later left that role entirely in December 2025 upon being confirmed as NASA Administrator, but the specific predicted outcome had already occurred).

sources.title: Lehigh Valley billionaire steps down as CEO of Shift4, will now be executive chairman
